On November 6, 2026, Gray Media, Inc. issued a press release announcing that its Board of Directors authorized a quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per share of its common stock and Class A common stock. The dividend is payable on December 31, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 15, 2026. A copy of the press release announcing the dividend is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report and incorporated herein by reference. Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits.
